T: A duke from 1876 discovers modern margarine.
D: A duke time-travels from 1876 to modern New York and falls for an ad executive.
P: Serve dinner when Leopold sets up the rooftop dinner.
S: Toasted baguette, whipped goat's cheese, honey poached pear and thyme
Baguette sliced thin on the bias, brushed with oil and toasted. Top with whipped goat's cheese, a few slices of poached pear and a drizzle of honey and thyme.
Three butters with sourdough and radishes
Cultured, salted and honey brown butter with warm sourdough
Three butters on a board: cultured, salted Irish, and brown butter whipped with honey. Warm sourdough and radishes with flaky salt.
M: Whole roast snapper with beurre blanc
Snapper stuffed with lemon, fennel and dill, new potatoes, white wine butter sauce
Whole snapper scored, stuffed with lemon, fennel and dill, roasted at 220C for 25 minutes. Beurre blanc (shallot, white wine and vinegar reduced, cold butter whisked in) and new potatoes.
Kate's steak frites with red wine butter
the late nights at the ad agency

Sirloin seared hard and rested, sliced, with shallot and red wine butter melting over the top and double-fried frites with sea salt. Reduce 150ml red wine with 1 finely chopped shallot until 2 tbsp remain, cool, then mash into 100g soft butter with parsley and salt. Cut 1kg potatoes into chips, soak 30 minutes, dry and fry at 140C for 6 minutes. Season 4 sirloin steaks (250g each) and sear in a smoking pan 3 minutes a side for medium rare, then rest 5 minutes. Fry the chips again at 190C for 3 minutes until crisp and salt them. Slice the steak and top with the butter.
W: Dark chocolate mousse lightened with whipped egg whites and cream
Melt 200g dark chocolate with 30g butter, whisk in 4 yolks, fold in 4 whites whipped to soft peaks with 40g sugar, then 150ml whipped cream. Set in glasses 4 hours.
K: Red wine punch with brandy, orange liqueur, sliced orange and cucumber
Red wine with brandy, orange and soda water over ice, the way a Victorian party served it.

steps.text: Slice the baguette thinly on the bias, brush with oil and toast at 200C.
Poach the sliced pears in simmering water with a little honey.
Spread the toasts with goat's cheese, top with pear and drizzle with honey and thyme.

dishes.n: Three butters with sourdough and radishes
dishes.make_ahead: Butters up to 2 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Brown the third butter in a pan.
Cool the browned butter, then whip with the honey.
Warm the loaf at 180C and slice.
Halve the radishes and serve with flaky salt for dipping, alongside the three butters.

dishes.n: Whole roast snapper with beurre blanc

steps.text: Score the fish and stuff with lemon slices, sliced fennel and dill.
Roast at 220C.
Boil the potatoes while the fish roasts.
Reduce the chopped shallot with the wine and vinegar.
Whisk in the cold butter cube by cube.
Rest the fish briefly and serve with the potatoes and sauce.
Melt the chocolate with the butter and cool slightly.
Whisk in the yolks.
Whip the whites to soft peaks with the sugar.
Softly whip the cream.
Fold the cream, then the whites, through the chocolate.
Spoon into glasses and chill until set. This chilling counts toward the cooking time.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled before adding ice

steps.text: Mix the wine, brandy, liqueur and sugar in a jug with the sliced orange and cucumber.
Chill.
Add ice and top with soda water.

s.note: Leopold's candlelit rooftop, set with proper manners
s.how: Slice a baguette thin on the bias, brush with oil and toast at 200C for 8 minutes. Poach 2 sliced pears in simmering water with honey for 5 minutes. Spread toasts with 150g whipped goat's cheese, top with pear and drizzle with honey and thyme.

s.note: Leopold refuses to lie about the diet margarine in the ad
s.how: Set out 100g cultured butter, 100g salted Irish butter and 100g butter browned, cooled and whipped with 1 tbsp honey. Warm 1 sourdough loaf at 180C for 8 minutes and slice. Halve 1 bunch radishes and serve with flaky salt for dipping.

m.note: roast fish, white linen and manners
m.how: Score a 1.5kg snapper, stuff with lemon slices, sliced fennel and dill, then roast at 220C for 25 minutes. Boil 800g new potatoes. Reduce 1 shallot with 100ml white wine and 2 tbsp vinegar, then whisk in 150g cold butter cube by cube.

w.note: an 1876 dessert that still holds up
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 30g butter. Whisk in 4 yolks, then fold in 4 whites whipped to soft peaks with 40g sugar, then 150ml softly whipped cream. Spoon into four glasses and set in the fridge for 4 hours before serving.

d.how: Mix 750ml red wine, 60ml brandy, 30ml orange liqueur and 2 tbsp sugar in a jug with sliced orange and cucumber. Chill 1 hour, then add ice and top with 400ml soda water.
